title.narrative: Support for Basic Education in Burkina Faso (Sahel Countries)

description.narrative: A project to support the basic education sector in Burkina Faso in the areas most affected and in need due to the Sahel and Lake Chad crisis. The project aims to provide free education and distribute school bags and uniforms to increase school enrollment rates for children of displaced families, refugees and host communities, through 6 schools in the Ouagadougou area. As part of the project's sustainability and integration, a number of displaced and host community families were supported and equipped with the tools and skills needed to practice income-generating activities, with a mechanism designed to support the education sector by empowering and linking beneficiary families to the production of school uniforms for the schools cooperating in this project.

Support basic education and increase school enrollment rates for displaced and refugee children and the most vulnerable families affected by the crisis in Burkina Faso. Specific objectives: 1) Provide educational support to a specific number of students from the most needy category. 2) Encourage school enrollment and reduce dropout rates among boys and girls. 3) Provide support to a number of families, equipping them with the tools and skills needed to practice income-generating activities.
Support basic education in Burkina Faso to increase school enrollment rates for children of displaced families, refugees and host communities.
Disbursement for "Support for Basic Education in Burkina Faso (Sahel Countries)" in Burkina Faso, implemented by Al-Ra'fah Humanitarian Association
